query: Lisbon Portugal points of interest attractions

results.title: Belém Tower - UNESCO World Heritage Site
results.snippet: Iconic 16th-century fortress on the Tagus River. Visit duration: 1-2 hours. A symbol of Portugal's Age of Discovery.

results.title: Jerónimos Monastery - Lisbon's Architectural Masterpiece
results.snippet: Stunning Manueline architecture and the final resting place of Vasco da Gama. Allow 2-3 hours for exploration.

results.title: Alfama District - Historic Lisbon Neighborhood
results.snippet: Wander the narrow streets of Lisbon's oldest district. Experience Fado music, local cuisine, and medieval charm. Half-day recommended.

results.title: Time Out Market Lisbon - Culinary Paradise
results.snippet: Gourmet food hall showcasing Portugal's best chefs. Perfect for lunch or dinner. Plan for 1-2 hours.

results.title: São Jorge Castle - Panoramic Views of Lisbon
results.snippet: Medieval Moorish castle with breathtaking city views. Interactive exhibits on Lisbon's history. 2-3 hours recommended.
